But hold on — the picture you've shown me doesn't match what you asked me to try. That's the opposite action — it looks like they got marked read, not added. So I can't actually confirm the "add" worked from this; if anything it's showing the wrong result.

Could you show me the state right after choosing "add to Read later" — where the two get added and I'd expect the Read later count to climb to 2? Once I see that, I can confirm the add is clear.
